hero.headline: Bringing the models behind public decisions within everyone's reach.
hero.hook: Interactive.li turns the models behind energy, economic, environmental and health policy into live sessions in which participants take the decisions themselves, compare their results, and see the trade-offs each choice involves.
hero.poster_link: Presented at the 25th Austrian Climate Day, Innsbruck, 23–25 April 2025
hero.pitch: Energy, economic, environmental and health policy all rest on models that are costly to run and, in practice, used only by specialists — invisible to the people the decisions affect. Interactive.li wraps an interactive layer around such models, whatever the subject. Small groups work from their own phones, tablets or laptops: briefed on a challenge, they discuss it and submit a decision, and the model answers in the terms that matter for that field — cost, risk, emissions, health outcomes, the reactions of those involved. Game mechanics — objectives, scoring, teams — focus the discussion: participants cooperate within their team and compete with the others. They then compare results and debrief, with generative AI turning everyone's answers into something a facilitator can use on the spot. Nothing here predicts the future or names a right answer. What participants leave with is a sense of the constraints, and of what every choice gains and gives up.

experiences.headline: Simulations
experiences.intro: A growing set of ready-to-run simulations, each built around a working model and delivered live — from briefing and group discussion through to a shared debriefing.

generations.title: Generations
generations.hook: Steer a decades-long programme to site a deep geological repository for radioactive waste, with stakeholder groups simulated by a large language model responding at every stage. Points are won by meeting expectations; a single veto ends the programme.

epidemic.title: Epidemic Crisis Manager
epidemic.hook: Act as a regional policymaker containing a fast-spreading outbreak, with linked epidemiological and economic models showing round by round what each measure buys and what it costs.

beyond_coal.title: Beyond Coal
beyond_coal.hook: Design the future electricity mix of a coal-dependent country, then submit it to an energy-system optimiser that reports back on cost, emissions and reliability — and shows how hard all three are to secure at once.
